title: [Sutana's Designs, Office]
description: Polished timber floors, partially covered by an oversized red-on-black mandala rug, span the room, stretching between oak-paneled walls.  Arranged upon a carved mahogany desk are ledgers, stacks of parchment, and labeled material samples.  Along three walls, shelves hold miniature facade models, roof tiles, and wood panels, while a tall brass lamp in one corner casts light across the windowless room.
